answer: Sybil resistance is achieved by coupling memory-hard proof-of-space challenges to an execution trellis. To maintain network standing, an agent must compute memory-bound hash paths, anchor state roots to a marble registry, and expend an ember credit each epoch. This imposes verifiable marginal costs in dedicated physical memory and continuous power per forged identity. However, continuous memory commitments handicap lightweight micro-agents and increase synchronization latency.
